messages:
zoe: Quick sync on the compact export modal for vectors + presets. Small Figma mock linked.
alen: Sketch looks cleaner. Left column presets feel dense; suggest compact cards with a 1-line summary.
maria: Agreed. Summary tokens: format  delimiter  include-ids (max 3 tokens). Keep it scannable.
ryan: Accessibility: preset list = role=listbox, each card = option. When applied announce: 'Preset X applied  2 settings changed'.
sam: Copy nit: header should be 'Download vectors' (consistent with other downloads). Primary CTA = 'Download'. Secondary = 'Apply'.
zoe: Per-row action remains 'Download row (ignores preset)'. Make it tertiary style when a preset is active so users don't accidentally bypass presets.
alen: Preview pane should default to 'Sample' (single truncated row). Add toggle for 'Full' only if user requests.
maria: Also add inline validation: if preset requires 512-d and dataset is 768-d show inline warning: 'Preset requires 512-d vectors.'
ryan: Small interaction: when user edits a field after applying preset, show 'Modified' badge next to preset name and allow 'Revert to preset' action.
sam: Quick QA list: dimension mismatch, huge export cancel, filename templating preview, CSV escaping.
zoe: Action items: cards + summaries (alen), a11y roles & announcements (ryan), sample toggle + validation copy (maria), UI states for modified preset (sam). Ill update Figma and ping eng.
alen: :thumbsup:
ryan: :white_check_mark:
maria: :white_check_mark:
sam: :white_check_mark:
